caseName: Bishop v. Great Lakes Towing Co.
caseNameFull: James F. Bishop, Administrator, etc. v. Great Lakes Towing Company

opinions.text: October 25,1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied. Mr. Harry W. Standidge for petitioners. Mr. Harvey D. Goulder, Mr. Thomas H. Garry and Mr. Ralph F. Potter for respondent.
